_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: without the floor, a truncated scan passes green (buggy)
expectedRed.why: On correct code the floor is 1000 and a 300-file scan fails closed, so the assertion that withinLimit=true fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the floor guard was removed or neutralised.
